title: DeepLink Parameters
description: Parameters for the fractal viewer URL hash fragment. The viewer reads these from window.location.hash on load and encodes them on every navigation action. Format: BASE_URL/#f={f}&x={x}&y={y}&ps={ps}&r={r}&i={i}&p={p}. Advanced exploration modes add optional fields for Julia parameters, palette physics, deep zoom, 3D studio state, and mathematical overlays.

f.description: Fractal identifier (snake_case). Must match an id in /api/fractals.json. The viewer falls back to 'mandelbrot' for unknown values.

x.description: Center X coordinate on the real axis of the complex plane

y.description: Center Y coordinate on the imaginary axis of the complex plane

ps.description: Pixel size: how many complex-plane units correspond to one pixel. Controls zoom level. Typical values: 4e-3 (full view), 1e-6 (deep zoom), 1e-12 (extreme zoom). The viewer uses logarithmic interpolation during animated navigation.

r.description: Rotation angle in radians. Applied to the complex plane before sampling. Range: 0 to 2π (values outside are accepted but normalized). Default: 0.

i.description: Maximum iterations for escape-time computation. Higher values reveal finer detail at the cost of render time. Default: 256.

p.description: Color palette identifier. Default: aurora. Use /api/palettes.json for descriptions.

jr.description: Julia-family parameter c real part, used by the Carte des paramètres and Julia sliders.

ji.description: Julia-family parameter c imaginary part, used by the Carte des paramètres and Julia sliders.

cm.description: Palette Physics coloring mode. Default: standard.

ph.description: Palette phase offset for animated/phase coloring modes.

pc.description: Set to 1 to reinforce iteration contour lines in Palette Physics.

lc.description: L-system line coloring mode for applied Atelier L-system proposals. Default: progression.

lsw.description: Applied L-system proposal stroke width. Default: 1.35.

azi.description: Set to 1 to enable automatic iteration scaling in Mode Abysses.

mat.description: Studio 3D material hint for WebGL fractals.

ov.description: Comma-separated mathematical weather overlays. Supported values: grille, contours, orbite.

lp.description: Set to 1 when an Atelier L-système proposal is applied as the active temporary line rendering.

la.description: Applied L-system proposal turn angle in degrees.

lr.description: Applied L-system proposal rewrite rules, separated by newlines or semicolons, e.g. F=F+F--F+F. Stochastic alternatives may be weighted, e.g. F=0.5:FF|0.5:F[+F].

fpa.description: Set to 1 when an Atelier formule proposal is applied as the active temporary escape-time rendering.

ffi.description: Applied formula iteration expression, e.g. z^2+c+a*sin(z).
